title: Frontend: Chart + Components
description: Create reusable UI components for strategy backtest: EquityCurve (recharts line chart for equity curve), TradeTable (sortable trade records table), RuleBuilder (dropdown-based condition builder for buy/sell rules). These components are used by StrategyBacktestPage.

criteria: EquityCurve component renders recharts LineChart with date X-axis, equity Y-axis, and drawdown area. Dark theme compatible.
TradeTable component renders sortable table with columns: trade_type, trade_date, price, shares, commission, profit, profit_rate. Color-coded profit/loss.
RuleBuilder component provides dropdown-based condition builder: select indicator pair, select operator (cross_over/cross_under/gt/lt), add/remove conditions, combine with and/or logic
RuleBuilder outputs rule expressions matching backend format: 'cross_over(ma_5, ma_20)', 'macd_dif > macd_dea'
All components use Tailwind dark theme matching existing UI
StrategyBacktestPage integrates all 3 components replacing placeholders
recharts package added to package.json if not already present
convergence.verification: Page renders with interactive chart, sortable table, and functional rule builder
convergence.definition_of_done: All 3 components render correctly and integrate with StrategyBacktestPage
